# r2 script menus: m03_scroll (generated by gen.py; edit gen.py, not this file)
# Each menu: a RAM script at the call site's x,y with that site's message; every row snapped.
# Battle-room menus are drawn in their facility's lobby (the battle rooms run map scripts on entry).
start saves/r2menus_postgame.sav
include ../continue.txt
# the save has never entered the Frontier: skip the Reception Gate's first-visit scene
ev setvar VAR_HAS_ENTERED_BATTLE_FRONTIER, 1; end

# tutor1  (BattleFrontier_Lounge7_hns:20-29)
warptoloose MAP_BATTLE_FRONTIER_LOUNGE7_HNS 4 9
waitnotask map_name_popup:Task_MapNamePopUpWindow 600
evstart lockall; message 0x@BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMove_hns@; waitmessage; special ShowBattlePointsWindow; setvar VAR_0x8004, SCROLL_MULTI_BF_MOVE_TUTOR_1; setvar VAR_0x8006, 0; special ShowScrollableMultichoice; waitstate; special CloseBattleFrontierTutorWindow; special CloseBattlePointsWindow; closemessage; releaseall; end
talk tutor1_m 40 - field_specials:ScrollableMultichoice_ProcessInput
scrollshots tutor1_r DOWN 11 8
tap B 0
waitctl 900
